boundary.description: From the junction of Nell Lane and Mauldeth Road West, SE along Nell Lane, Northern Grove, Barlow Moor Road, S along Palatine Road to the point where it meets River Mersey, and N along River Mersey to the point opposite Rifle Road. Then by a beeline E to Hardy Lane, excluding Betel UK – Manchester. E along Hardy Lane and Mauldeth Road West to its junction with Nell Lane.
